comparison.objective: Assemble and phase a rack-and-pinion gripper so both fingers open symmetrically.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat a loose rack into a pinion at the correct tooth phase and verify coupled symmetric travel.
comparison.success_condition: Both racks seated and drive at least 15 mm travel with center error within tolerance; released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Gear meshing and phase alignment are precision assembly skills unrelated to sieve agitation and particle classification.
